menu.debugmenu.title: Debug Menu
debugmenu.entry.overlay.desc: Master switch for the F3 screen: entries set to overlay-only show while it is open.
debugmenu.entry.advanced_tooltips.desc: Adds the item id, durability and component data to item tooltips.
debugmenu.entry.focus_pause.desc: Pauses singleplayer when the game window loses focus.
debugmenu.entry.profiler_chart.desc: Pie chart on the overlay showing where the frame time goes.
debugmenu.entry.fps_charts.desc: Frame time graph over the last seconds.
debugmenu.entry.network_charts.desc: Ping and bandwidth graphs for the current connection.
debugmenu.entry.lightmap_texture.desc: Draws the lightmap texture the renderer samples for lighting.
debugmenu.entry.reload_chunks.desc: Rebuilds the geometry of every loaded chunk.
debugmenu.entry.reload_resource_packs.de: Reloads textures, models, sounds and shaders from the resource packs.
debugmenu.entry.copy_location.desc: Copies your position to the clipboard as an /execute ... run tp command.
debugmenu.entry.dump_version.desc: Prints the client, data and pack versions to chat.
debugmenu.entry.dump_dynamic_textures.de: Saves every texture atlas as a PNG inside the game directory.
debugmenu.entry.profiling.desc: Records a profiling run and saves the result under debug/.
debugmenu.entry.debug_options.desc: Opens the vanilla Debug Options screen.
debugmenu.entry.cycle_spectator.desc: Switches between spectator and your previous game mode; needs operator permission.
debugmenu.entry.game_version.desc: Client version, launched version and the client name reported by the mod loader.
debugmenu.entry.fps.desc: Frames per second, the frame limit and whether vsync is on.
debugmenu.entry.tps.desc: Server tick rate, plus the average packets sent and received.
debugmenu.entry.memory.desc: Heap use as a percentage and in MiB, with the allocation rate.
debugmenu.entry.detailed_memory.desc: Heap and non-heap usage read from the JVM memory bean.
debugmenu.entry.system_specs.desc: Processor, graphics device info and the Java version the client runs on.
debugmenu.entry.looking_at_block_state.d: Identifier and block state properties of the block you are looking at.
debugmenu.entry.looking_at_block_tags.de: Tags of the block under the crosshair.
debugmenu.entry.looking_at_fluid_state.d: Identifier and fluid state of the fluid you are looking at.
debugmenu.entry.looking_at_fluid_tags.de: Tags of the fluid under the crosshair.
debugmenu.entry.looking_at_entity.desc: Registered name of the entity the crosshair is on.
debugmenu.entry.looking_at_entity_tags.d: Tags of the entity under the crosshair.
debugmenu.entry.chunk_render_stats.desc: Counts of rendered and queued chunk sections.
debugmenu.entry.chunk_generation_stats.d: Generation stage of the chunk you stand in; integrated server only.
debugmenu.entry.entity_render_stats.desc: How many entities are drawn out of those loaded.
debugmenu.entry.chunk_source_stats.desc: Client chunk cache statistics: loaded and cached chunks.
debugmenu.entry.player_position.desc: Block coordinates, chunk coordinates and the direction you face.
Your coordinates inside the current 16x16x16 chunk section.
debugmenu.entry.light_levels.desc: Block light and sky light at your position, read from the light engine.
debugmenu.entry.heightmap.desc: Heightmap value at your position for each heightmap type.
debugmenu.entry.local_difficulty.desc: Local difficulty, moon brightness and how long the chunk has been inhabited.
debugmenu.entry.day_count.desc: Number of in-game days elapsed in the overworld.
debugmenu.entry.entity_spawn_counts.desc: Mobs per spawn category and the number of spawnable chunks; integrated server only.
debugmenu.entry.sound_mood.desc: Playing and streaming sound channels, plus the cave mood level.
debugmenu.entry.sound_cache.desc: Number of cached sound buffers and the memory they take.
debugmenu.entry.post_effect.desc: Identifier of the post-processing shader currently applied.
debugmenu.entry.entity_hitboxes.desc: Draws entity hitboxes and a line showing where each entity looks.
debugmenu.entry.chunk_borders.desc: Draws the borders of the chunk you stand in and its section grid.
debugmenu.entry.3d_crosshair.desc: Replaces the crosshair with three axis lines showing world orientation.
debugmenu.entry.chunk_section_paths.desc: Draws the traversal paths the culling pass takes between chunk sections.
debugmenu.entry.gpu_utilization.desc: Graphics card load as a percentage, turning red under heavy load.
debugmenu.entry.simple_performance_impac: Lists enabled settings that cost performance, such as clouds and improved transparency.
debugmenu.entry.chunk_section_octree.des: Draws the octree the renderer uses to group chunk sections.
debugmenu.entry.visualize_water_levels.d: Draws the fluid level of each water block.
debugmenu.entry.visualize_heightmap.desc: Draws the heightmap surface above the terrain.
debugmenu.entry.visualize_collision_boxe: Draws the collision boxes entities actually collide with.
debugmenu.entry.visualize_entity_support: Highlights the block each entity is standing on.
debugmenu.entry.visualize_block_light_le: Draws the block light value at each position.
debugmenu.entry.visualize_sky_light_leve: Draws the sky light value at each position.
debugmenu.entry.visualize_solid_faces.de: Marks the block faces the game treats as solid.
debugmenu.entry.visualize_chunks_on_serv: Draws the status of each chunk on the server side.
debugmenu.entry.visualize_sky_light_sect: Outlines the chunk sections the sky light engine tracks.
debugmenu.entry.chunk_section_visibility: Draws which chunk sections the culling pass considers visible.
